owner: Independent Yggdrasil knowledge acquisition contributor; Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work PR #1278 sole model coordinator
question: Can prior native sufficient-constraint accumulation on SAME model slot preserve A across new task B while learning a fresh causal context from typed Q/P/Q facts selected without simulator-private role knowledge?
mechanism: Existing NativeContextAccumulator(context_bits=2).stage_update(address=0, max_degree=1) with phase as explicitly public numeric task bit and selected source-derived numeric mode bit, action/outcome from separately revealed synthetic interventions; one shared address for both tasks, no fresh learner/controller/architecture.

per_seed.phase_bit_public: explicitly known phase=0 or 1, not inferred from outcome
per_seed.mode_truth: balanced 16 zeros/16 ones independently within FIT and HELD
per_seed.nuisance_features: balanced 8/8 within each truth stratum of FIT and HELD

role_selection: Fit each of four source predicates with existing NativeContextBasis(context_bits=1,max_degree=1) on only separately revealed FIT outcomes; exactly one fully supported candidate required, else abstain. Role selection is a helper, not canonical training.
source_rules: ONLY direct source-typed witnessed Q/P/Q bits and actual disclosed synthetic action consequences can be supplied; no inferred paths, no unseen held outcomes, no private role, no false owner authentication.
controls: Same-information full-refit NativeContextBasis(context_bits=2) on both batches, one slot
Independently fully fitted exact symbolic (phase,selected_bit,action)->reward counts, identical FIT source/actions
Fully fitted conventional depth-3 binary tree on (phase,selected_bit,action), identical evidence and task phase
Replacement-only NativeContextBasis(context_bits=2) stage_fit at same slot for phase B with no accumulation; test old-A retention
Phase-aware action-only control with no factual bit

metrics.primary: Mean exact Brier over 384 unseen entity/action outcomes, per arm; lower better
metrics.retention: Old A held forecast fingerprint before B, after B and cold restore at SAME native address 0
metrics.action_reward: Optimal action selection for 192 held entities
metrics.cost: wall time, stage checkpoint size, parent readout equality
metrics.abstention: Unsupported, conflicting or forged source and duplicate evidence

engineering_go.regression: mandatory root+contributor+G29 dual OS final candidate followed by already consumed original-image job

scientific_go.on_tie: DEV_NO_GO_STRONGEST_CONTROL_TIE, even if native cumulative memory prevents forgetting relative to replacement-only
